newsitem.title: UK: Wace rebounds as stock inventories cleared.
newsitem.headline: Wace rebounds as stock inventories cleared.

text.p: Shares in Wace Group Plc, which have been market underperformers, rebounded on Monday amid perceptions that sellers finally have been cleared out of the market, dealers said.
By 1414 GMT, the shares were up 6-1/2p to 42-1/2.

As recently as early May, the UK imaging and printing specialist had issued a profit warning, sparking a wave of selling that left relatively large inventories of stock on market makers' books, dealers said.
"The shares have been tipped in the press in the last few months, but they couldn't really go up because the market makers had too much stock," said one dealer.
"But it seems that a lot of that underlying stock has been cleared," he added. "And we're seeing some interest from private clients."
